You wash your hands and begin the close, careful work of mending what has been torn.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge

One hour per attempt; at most once per wound per day.

Self or one willing patient; one hour
Duration
Recovery progress persists for that wound; completed treatment removes only its listed treatable penalties.

None.

Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Requires a wound listing Soft Tissue treatment; once per wound per day across all healers. Meet its recovery value to remove only its listed treatable penalties. The scar and accumulated wound count remain.

1 recovery progress.
